description: Ruben and I have been building things together since UC Santa Cruz in 2014: game design, software, art, pottery, food, and more. Twelve years of knowing how the other works is worth a lot on a 48-hour deadline. I grew up in San Jose and am now a CS PhD student at Buffalo researching speech and audio analysis. Ruben still lives in San Jose, works in Python, graphics, VR and AI, and has been an artist the whole time. We registered with San Jose because that’s home.
